title: The Lantern-Bearing Fox
statement: They say when the first winter grew too dark for travelers to find their way, a small fox stole a fallen star and carried it in her jaws, tail streaming behind like a comet, laying down a path of light for whoever came after. She never stopped walking — and on clear nights you can still see her midway across the sky, lantern held high, offering her stolen star to anyone lost enough to look up.
